name: Bayesian Cable Curl
instructions: Set a single handle on a low pulley, face away from the stack and take a split stance with the working arm behind your body.
Let the cable pull your arm back so the biceps is stretched, keeping the elbow just behind the torso.
Curl the handle up without letting the elbow drift forward, then lower slowly into the stretch.

name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Set a handle at the lowest pulley position and stand side-on to the stack, holding the handle with the far hand.
With a slight bend in the elbow, raise the arm out to the side until it is about level with the shoulder.
Lower under control, keeping tension on the cable at the bottom.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Adjust the seat so the machine's pivot lines up with your shoulder joints and place the pads against the outside of your arms.
Raise the arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, leading with the elbows.
Lower slowly without letting the weight stack touch down between reps.

name: Lean-Away Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Hold a sturdy upright with one hand and lean your body away from it, dumbbell in the other hand.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side until the arm is roughly level with the shoulder.
Lower slowly; the lean keeps tension on the side delts at the bottom of the movement.

name: Egyptian Lateral Raise
instructions: Set a handle on a low pulley, hold the machine with the near hand and lean your body away from the stack.
Take the handle with the far hand across the front of your body and raise it out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower under control, letting the arm cross slightly in front of the body at the bottom.

name: Cable Y-Raise
instructions: Set two handles at the lowest position and grab them with crossed arms, the left cable in the right hand and vice versa.
Step back and raise both arms up and out into a Y shape, thumbs pointing up.
Return slowly to the start without letting the shoulders shrug up.

name: Katana Triceps Extension
instructions: Set a handle on a low pulley and stand side-on, holding it with the far hand behind your opposite shoulder like drawing a sword.
Keeping the upper arm still, extend the elbow up and out until the arm is straight overhead at an angle.
Lower back behind the shoulder into a deep stretch.

name: Cross-Body Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Set two handles at shoulder height or slightly above and grab them with crossed arms, elbows bent in front of your face.
Extend both elbows out to the sides until the arms are straight, keeping the upper arms still.
Return slowly until the hands cross in front of you.

name: Pendulum Squat
instructions: Step into the pendulum squat machine with your back against the pad and feet in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety and squat down as deep as your knees allow, keeping your back on the pad.
Drive through the whole foot to stand back up without locking the knees hard.

name: Belt Squat
instructions: Attach the belt around your hips and stand on the platform with feet about shoulder width apart.
Holding the handles for balance, squat down with an upright torso to a comfortable depth.
Stand back up by driving the hips up and the knees forward over the toes.

name: Pin Squat
instructions: Set the safety pins in a rack at your target depth and squat the bar down until it rests on the pins.
Pause briefly so the bar settles and the stretch reflex is gone.
Stand up from a dead stop, keeping the chest up and the bar over mid-foot.

name: Pause Squat
instructions: Squat down with a barbell on your back as in a regular back squat.
Hold the bottom position for 1–2 seconds while staying tight.
Drive back up without bouncing out of the hole.

name: Paused Bench Press
instructions: Unrack the bar and lower it to your lower chest as in a regular bench press.
Pause the bar motionless on the chest for about one second.
Press back up to lockout while keeping the shoulder blades pinned.

name: Larsen Press
instructions: Lie on the bench and lift your legs, either straight out or with the feet hovering above the floor.
Lower the bar to your chest and press it back up without any help from leg drive.
Keep the torso stable; the setup removes leg drive and adds a stability demand.

name: Nordic Ham Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your ankles anchored under a bench, machine pad or partner.
Keeping hips extended, lower your torso toward the floor as slowly as possible.
Catch yourself with your hands, then push off lightly and curl back up with the hamstrings.

name: Reverse Nordic
instructions: Kneel upright with your shins on a pad and your feet anchored or pointed behind you.
Keeping a straight line from knees to head, lean back as far as you can control.
Return to upright by contracting the quads, without bending at the hips.

name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor and the top leg resting on a bench at the inner knee or ankle.
Lift your hips so the body forms a straight line, with the bottom leg hanging free or lifted.
Hold the position, then repeat on the other side.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Hinge over with a flat back until the torso is close to parallel with the floor, bar resting on the floor.
Row the bar explosively to your lower chest without raising the torso.
Return the bar to the floor and reset before each rep.

name: Kroc Row
instructions: Brace one hand on a bench or rack and hold a heavy dumbbell in the other hand.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip with a little body english, for high reps.
Lower under control into a full stretch.

name: Seal Row
instructions: Lie face down on a high flat bench with the bar on the floor or on blocks under you.
Row the bar up to the underside of the bench, keeping your chest on the pad.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

name: Meadows Row
instructions: Set up beside the end of a landmine barbell in a staggered stance and grab the bar end with an overhand grip.
Row the bar up and back toward your hip, keeping the elbow away from the body.
Lower slowly into a stretch.

name: Helms Row
instructions: Stand behind an incline bench and lean your chest against the top of the pad, dumbbells hanging down.
Row the dumbbells up without lifting your chest off the pad.
Lower under control to full extension.

name: Machine Chest-Supported Row
instructions: Adjust the seat so the chest pad sits at mid-chest and you can just reach the handles.
Row the handles toward your torso, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until the arms are straight and the shoulder blades spread.

name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Set a handle on a high pulley and kneel on the knee on the working side, facing the stack.
Pull the handle down toward your hip, driving the elbow down and back.
Let the arm rise into a full overhead stretch before the next rep.

name: Machine Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Select the counterweight and kneel or stand on the assistance platform, gripping the pull-up handles.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the handles.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Single-Leg Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the leg press and place one foot in the middle of the platform, the other leg off to the side.
Lower the platform as deep as you can without the hips lifting off the seat.
Press back up without locking the knee, then switch legs.
